<style>
/* ==========================================================================
   Colégio Unicultura | Home - Seção "Depoimentos" (vai embutido no JSON dela)
   Escopo: .un-depo. Desktop/tablet: duas colunas de cards subindo/descendo sem
   fim (pausa no hover). Celular: carrossel horizontal de arrastar.
   ========================================================================== */

/* Aspas gigantes decorativas no fundo + brilho vermelho suave */
.un-depo {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.un-depo::after {
  content: "\201C";
  position: absolute;
  top: -80px;
  left: -20px;
  z-index: 0;
  font: 700 520px/1 "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.un-depo > .e-con-inner::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  right: 8%;
  bottom: 10%;
  width: 420px;
  height: 420px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(241, 5, 5, 0.28), rgba(241, 5, 5, 0) 70%);
  filter: blur(20px);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.un-depo > .e-con-inner > * {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Colunas com rolagem infinita
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .un-depo .un-depo-cols {
    height: 640px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
}

.un-depo .un-depo-cols {
  -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(transparent, #000 12%, #000 88%, transparent);
  mask-image: linear-gradient(transparent, #000 12%, #000 88%, transparent);
}

.un-depo .un-depo-track {
  animation: un-depo-up 46s linear infinite;
}

.un-depo .un-depo-track--down {
  animation-duration: 54s;
  animation-direction: reverse;
}

.un-depo .un-depo-cols:hover .un-depo-track {
  animation-play-state: paused;
}

@keyframes un-depo-up {
  from { transform: translateY(0); }
  to   { transform: translateY(-50%); }
}

/* Zigue-zague: cards alternam um recuo, como no Figma */
.un-depo .un-depo-set > .un-depo-card:nth-child(even) {
  margin-left: 24px;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Card
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.un-depo .un-depo-card {
  transition: translate 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 0.35s ease;
}

.un-depo .un-depo-card:hover {
  translate: 0 -4px;
  box-shadow: 0 22px 44px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
}

/* Aspas vermelhas do card */
.un-depo .un-depo-quote .elementor-heading-title {
  height: 34px;
  overflow: visible;
}

/* Avatar com iniciais */
.un-depo .un-depo-avatar {
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* No editor: marca os cards como EXEMPLO (não aparece no site publicado) */
.elementor-editor-active .un-depo .un-depo-card::after {
  content: "EXEMPLO - substituir";
  position: absolute;
  top: 10px;
  right: 12px;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: #F10505;
  color: #FFFFFF;
  font: 700 10px/16px sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Celular: carrossel horizontal de arrastar (sem rolagem automática)
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .un-depo .un-depo-cols {
    overflow-x: auto;
    scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
    gap: 14px;
    padding-bottom: 12px;
    -webkit-mask-image: none;
    mask-image: none;
  }

  .un-depo .un-depo-track,
  .un-depo .un-depo-set {
    display: contents;
  }

  .un-depo .un-depo-dup {
    display: none;
  }

  .un-depo .un-depo-card,
  .un-depo .un-depo-set > .un-depo-card:nth-child(even) {
    flex: 0 0 84%;
    margin-left: 0;
    scroll-snap-align: start;
  }
}

/* Movimento reduzido: colunas paradas (dá para rolar dentro delas) */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .un-depo .un-depo-track {
    animation: none;
  }

  .un-depo .un-depo-cols {
    overflow-y: auto;
  }
}

/* Botão "Agendar visita": seta em círculo vermelho que gira no hover */
.un-depo .un-btn-arrow .elementor-button-icon {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: #F10505;
  color: #FFFFFF;
  fill: #FFFFFF;
  font-size: 12px;
  transition: transform 0.4s ease;
}

.un-depo .un-btn-arrow .elementor-button-icon svg {
  width: 1em;
  height: 1em;
  fill: currentColor;
}

.un-depo .un-btn-arrow .elementor-button-icon i,
.un-depo .un-btn-arrow .elementor-button-icon svg {
  transform: rotate(-45deg);
}

.un-depo .un-btn-arrow .elementor-button:hover .elementor-button-icon {
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}
</style>
<script>
/* Unicultura | Seção Depoimentos - contador dos números (classe .un-depo-count).
   Independente do script da Home. Não roda dentro do editor do Elementor. */
(function () {
  if (document.body.classList.contains('elementor-editor-active')) {
    return;
  }
  if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
    return;
  }
  function countUp(title) {
    var node = title.firstChild;
    if (!node || node.nodeType !== 3) {
      return;
    }
    var match = node.nodeValue.match(/([\d.]+)/);
    if (!match) {
      return;
    }
    var target = parseInt(match[1].replace(/\./g, ''), 10);
    var before = node.nodeValue.slice(0, match.index);
    var after = node.nodeValue.slice(match.index + match[1].length);
    var start = null;
    function frame(now) {
      if (start === null) {
        start = now;
      }
      var t = Math.min(1, (now - start) / 1600);
      node.nodeValue = before + Math.round(target * (1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3))).toLocaleString('pt-BR') + after;
      if (t < 1) {
        window.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      }
    }
    node.nodeValue = before + '0' + after;
    window.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('.un-depo .un-depo-count').forEach(function (widget) {
    var title = widget.querySelector('.elementor-heading-title');
    if (!title) {
      return;
    }
    var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      if (entries[0].isIntersecting) {
        observer.disconnect();
        window.setTimeout(function () { countUp(title); }, 300);
      }
    }, { threshold: 0.6 });
    observer.observe(widget);
  });
})();
</script>
